text:
samir.partners: Quick thread  we need a release-candidate handoff for the Gaudi + MI300 wave that includes: embargo/press blackout, canary rollout plan, explicit fallback mapping to H200/B200, SI install artifact owner, and rollback criteria.

mei-hw: I'll own HW artifacts (signed firmware hash, rc kernel tag, thermal logs). Vendor note: Habana said a microcode RC may come week of Jul 6 might push our freeze.

oliver-prod: Marketplace needs tile JSON + human fallback blurb + canary flag (to show "early access"). Legal requires exact blackout window. Proposed blackout: 2026-07-10 -> 2026-07-14.

tara-devex: Devex will provide quickstart, a canary test harness, and an SI installer tarball. Example smoke:```
./canary_run --model "llama2-13b" --seq 1024 --bs 1 --p50_target 130
```
We'll attach logs to the sheet.

fern-oncall: Ops: routing pseudocode: ```
if cap(mi300_region) < 0.18:
  route = ["h200_fallback","b200_fallback"]
elif p50_increase > 0.25:
  route = ["gaudi_degraded"]
```
Add explicit SLO downgrade bullet for canary customers.

samir.partners: SI handoff: owner + artifact list please. Also need a short customer comms blurb for the marketplace tile that explains fallback/expected perf delta.

mei-hw: SI artifact list: rc-image.tar.gz (tag: rc-gaudi-mi300-202607), bench-power.csv, firmware.sig. I'll DM vendor contact (raj@habana) and post the intro.

oliver-prod: Marketplace tile draft (snippet): ```json
{"sku":"rw-mi300-64g-rc","canary":true,"fallback":"H200/B200 may be used if MI300 capacity is constrained. Expect 10-30% latency regression."}
```
I'll add legal blackout dates and pricing slug in sheet.

tara-devex: SI note: installer includes `install.sh --mode si --verify-bench`. Add minimal runbook: rollback if p50 > 200ms for 30m during canary.

marketplace-bot: CI job queued: `ci/marketplace/rc-gaudi-mi300/canary-smoke` (status: queued).

fern-oncall: Filing INFRA-5299 for lab-image tag `rc-power-profile-2026-07`. Please link.

samir.partners: Recap owners: Mei -> HW artifacts & vendor intros; Oliver -> marketplace tile + blackout; Tara -> devex + SI installer; Fern -> ops playbook + infra ticket; Samir -> comms + press handoff.

samir.partners: I'll schedule a 20-min sync Fri 11:00 to confirm blackout and canary windows. If anyone needs to shift dates because of vendor microcode, flag here. :calendar:
